claims.claim: Employment (Equal Opportunities) Law 5748-1988, Section 2(a), prohibits an Israeli employer from discriminating between employees or between job applicants on grounds of sex, sexual orientation, personal status, pregnancy, fertility treatments, IVF treatments, parenthood, age, race, religion, nationality, country of origin, place of residence, worldview, political party, or reserve service, in hiring, terms of employment, promotion, professional training, and dismissal or severance pay.

claims.claim: Section 2(a) of the Employment (Equal Opportunities) Law, 5748-1988 forbids an employer from discriminating between employees or job applicants on grounds including sex, sexual orientation, personal status, pregnancy, fertility treatments, IVF treatments, parenthood, age, race, religion, nationality, country of origin, place of residence, outlook, party affiliation and reserve service. (סעיף 2 לחוק שוויון ההזדמנויות בעבודה).

claims.claim: Section 2(c) of Law 5748-1988 permits differential treatment necessitated by the character or nature of the assignment or post (a BFOQ-style carve-out).
claims.raw_snippet: Differential treatment necessitated by the character or nature of the assignment or post shall not be regarded as discrimination
